Hi Liam —

Hope you're okay — saw we missed the pilot walkthrough this morning. Totally understand travel and last-minute changes happen. Quick options to get you back on track:

2) 30-minute architecture walkthrough with the engineering lead (Marcus) — for deeper integration questions.
3) Async + recording — we record a focused 12-min runtime demo and follow up with written notes if that helps the execs.

If you can, send the best 2 slots in your timezone and we’ll lock something. If it helps, here’s a calendar link with my immediate availability: https://cal.com/sofia/redwood-30m?tz=America%2FLos_Angeles

Also attaching the latest demo deck so anyone on your side can skim before we meet (attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf).

Thanks —
